description: This file contains a JUnit test class, `SubjectModifiedStrategyUpdateTest`, which tests the behavior of the `SubjectModifiedStrategy` when applying a subject modification event with a modified label in the context of policy persistence and strategies. It extends an abstract test class and defines specific test methods for validating policy effect changes.

classes.name: SubjectModifiedStrategyUpdateTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class focused on testing the `SubjectModifiedStrategy` behavior when a subject modification event occurs, especially when the label is modified.

methods.name: getStrategyUnderTest
methods.description: Returns a new instance of `SubjectModifiedStrategy` for testing.

methods.name: getPolicyEvent
methods.description: Creates a `SubjectModified` event with specified instant and policy, simulating a subject modification with a new label.

methods.name: additionalAssertions
methods.description: Performs assertions to verify that existing permissions are unaffected and the new subject has correct permissions after the event application.
